messages:
Lena Moore: Quick thread 1. Bringing up Zenith-13B (Llama -> Gemma layout) for int4 runs. Seeing a head-clustered phase shift around token 40 that causes mild coherence drop.
Ravi Singh: Can you share conversion flags and a tiny diff?
Lena Moore: command below + sample.
```
python convert.py --src llama-zenith13b.ckpt --dst gemma/zenith13b.onnx --head-permute group4 --quant int4
```
Gold fp16: "...the study concluded the protocol was effective."
Quant int4: "...the study concluded the protocol was effective." (weird control char insertion near token 41)
Taylor Kim: Control-char often means tokenizer export mismatch. Which tokenizer binary/encoding did you bake into the model?
Lena Moore: We embedded the tokenizer.json from an older build without NFKC. Also noticed head groups 3-5 have per-head scale variance post-quant that correlates with phase step.
Ravi Singh: Hypothesis: group4 permute messed the mapping between rotary angle table and per-head quant scale. Int4's per-head asymmetric scaling amplifies small misalignments.
Taylor Kim: Quick checks: 1) run with `--preserve-tokenizer` to rule out encoding; 2) convert with `--no-head-permute` to see if permute is culprit.
Lena Moore: preserve-tokenizer fixes control-char. No-head-permute makes outputs nearly identical to fp16. So both issues exist.
DevOps-Bot: test/zenith-int4-rotary-smoke triggered.
Ravi Singh: Fix plan: add converter step to remap rotary angle buffers and remap per-head scale arrays after any head permute. Add tokenizer canonicalize (NFKC) as default export.
Taylor Kim: Also add a small runtime loader checksum to auto-detect head-order mismatch and warn.
Lena Moore: I'll open PR with a failing->fixed smoke test, include calibration stats and a short perf note (converter remap is negligible runtime). Owner: @Lena. Target: land to staging by EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
